The wood grain is somewhat uniform and lacks the micro-variations of real wood. It has a slightly 'painted-on' or procedural texture appearance.
The connection point between the lower metallic circle and the wooden stem is ambiguous. It appears to float or merge slightly without a clear mechanical mounting bracket or screw points.
The smaller instrument in the background has slightly warped geometry that doesn't perfectly align with the perspective of the wall, appearing slightly flattened.
